driver_applications_decision_fields_chk.name: driver_applications_decision_fields_chk
driver_applications_decision_fields_chk.value: ("driver_applications"."status" not in ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')) or ("driver_applications"."decided_at" is not null and "driver_applications"."decided_by_account_id" is not null)

session_refresh_replacement_state_chk.name: session_refresh_replacement_state_chk
session_refresh_replacement_state_chk.value: "session_refresh_tokens"."replaced_by_id" is null or "session_refresh_tokens"."rotated_at" is not null

sessions_revocation_reason_chk.name: sessions_revocation_reason_chk
sessions_revocation_reason_chk.value: "sessions"."revoked_at" is null or "sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null

account_role_scopes_reference_chk.name: account_role_scopes_reference_chk
account_role_scopes_reference_chk.value: ("account_role_scopes"."scope_type" = 'GLOBAL' and "account_role_scopes"."scope_reference_id" is null) or ("account_role_scopes"."scope_type" = 'CITY' and "account_role_scopes"."scope_reference_id" is not null)

cities_archived_at_chk.name: cities_archived_at_chk
cities_archived_at_chk.value: ("cities"."status" = 'ARCHIVED' and "cities"."archived_at" is not null) or ("cities"."status" <> 'ARCHIVED' and "cities"."archived_at" is null)
